headline: Lipscomb beats the table's top three away from home
dek: Lipscomb won three of its ten conference matches and finished sixth. It then won by one goal at Bellarmine, North Florida and FGCU in the space of eight days, the last of them against a side that had lost once in conference play.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring splits the conference in two: West Florida, lowest of the rest, scored more goals than Queens University of Charlotte and Stetson together.

wire.line: FGCU's only home defeat came against Lipscomb, in the last match it hosted.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their dates with no result published, every one of them before the season's first published score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: West Florida conceded eleven goals while winning eight, drawing four and losing four.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sunnie Woodard kept five shutouts in goal for Lipscomb.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: At least fourteen different players have scored for Jacksonville.

last_match.line: The defeat ended Lipscomb's run of wins at Bellarmine, North Florida and FGCU.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
